title: Earth Hour
body:
How often do you think of the Earth in your day-to-day decision making?

  1. a) Always
  2. b) Sometimes
  3. c) Never

If you are in the c) category, then Earth Hour is for you! It’s a chance for all of us to spend one hour connecting with the Earth, to remember how blessed we are to be alive on this wonderful planet, to be grateful for the nourishment it provides and to think about how it sustains all our activities.

Join us by switching off your non-essential electric lights, for one hour from 8:30 to 9:30 pm (your local time) on Saturday 23 March, as a symbol of commitment to the planet.
